title: Osha Aniseya
description: Osha Aniseya was born to a coven of witches and was raised to uphold the values and traditions of their culture, but after an unexpected encounter with a group of Jedi, her path changed forever. Osha trained as Master Sol's Padawan for years before leaving the Order to become a meknek for hire. Her sister, Mae, long thought dead, later disguised herself as Osha as a means to infiltrate the Jedi and murder Master Sol, but the act instead fortuitously brought the sisters back together.
